review.notes: Full review of README (2476 lines) and Suggested.lean (no declarations; docstring names the four headlines and their missing carriers, checked at the pins). Seeded sample of 15 sections (2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.3b, 2.3c, 2.3a, 2.4, 2.8, 2.9c, 3.1, 3.1a, 3.1d, 3.5, 3.6, 3.8) checked by computation and against [FormalProof], read as Lean source in the operator's local copy: all 69 file-and-declaration locators resolve, 31 declarations opened and compared (Ranks, Scale, RankVal, HostVal, HCVal, HCParam, Host.xi0, szlStar, SizeNodes, SizeLstar, nonempty_hFrame, VandermondeCountExplicit, ClassNumberFormula2, DGamDvdF, ColumnChain.col/wt, exists_thetaVectorFamily_of_curveDatum, th22, HalfValuation and others). [Announcement] read in full. Numerical rechecks in plain Python: sqrt(-d)*s2 for d=7..163, theta0''(0) at d=7, the cube identity of 2.6, the exceptional sets of 2.7. Automatic checks all passed; depcheck 171 roadmaps, 1996 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean of Suggested.lean exits 0 with no messages. No finding. Corrections: Layer 3 introduction names L the coefficient field (it is the field of places); delta_T equals the cited Host.xi0 only at the unit ideal; the description's generality sentence against 3.1d and 3.3. Format notes: the word 'follows'; a locator for 2.3a. For the human reviewers: scope of the unrefereed formal proof, the unproved wider form of 3.1d and 3.3 outside d = 7 mod 16, the licence of the formal proof.
